title: 'The sealed dispatch for Marrowgate' has a destination mismatch: the courier who hands it over says 'Highward. Watch post there will know what to do with it,' but the item itself is titled 'for Marrowgate' and its tooltip reads 'meant for the Watch post at Highward.' I carried it all the way into Marrowgate and no NPC or location there (or at Highward) ever offered a delivery option for it.
where: The Roadside Hollow, Wardmoor east road
